pull_request.title: Calorimeter: summarize EM findings in an eight-page review
pull_request.head: codex/emcal-findings-report
pull_request.body:
Addresses [review comment6951330371](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/pull/145#issuecomment-6951330371): records the human selection of ALLEGRO-style LAr with a 400 mm warm gap as the nODD ECAL working baseline and adds the requested single SVG comparison.

The [SVG](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/emcal-findings-report/docs/publication/emcal-findings/response-comparison.svg) and updated eight-page [PDF](https://github.com/asalzburger/nodd/blob/codex/emcal-findings-report/docs/publication/emcal-findings/review.pdf) show ODD, nODD Si-W, physically staggered Si-W, and LAr400. The three matched 10k saved-hit samples are rebinned to uniform 0.05-wide |eta| bins with all zeros and 1000 shared whole-primary bootstrap replicates, seed13001000. ODD is explicitly limited to its retained 20 GeV/c, fixed-phi, 200-event eta0/1/2 reference markers and source intervals; no matched broad-spectrum ODD curve is invented. The observable is SD(H/Etrue)/mean(H/Etrue), a raw-response sigma(E)/E proxy, not intrinsic fixed-energy resolution.

The baseline-selection record and layout pages distinguish the selected LAr400 design from the maintained 800 mm combined-export/drawing integration control. Connected services, collar/FCAL fit, readout boundary correction and engineering qualification remain open. No geometry, material, readout, transport or calibration is changed, and no old native proof is relabelled.

Retargets the report to main and ordinarily incorporates the already approved/merged dependency branches: main currently contains #142, while #143/#144/#146 merged into their parent branches. This preserves their code, exact scientific receipts, reviewed numerical-test correction, canonical token owners and interaction evidence. No GitHub PR merge is performed by this response.

Validation: all three input hashes and 10,000 exact primary identities; all60bins/model retain 136-189 primaries; existing ten fine LAr H bins/intervals reproduce; swapped-geometry ledger rejected. Independent PhysVal review reproduces all180bin statistics and every interval by direct-index resampling. Report is eight pages, all pages visually checked, PDF text/bounds/footers/11links and artifact hashes pass. Existing18 response controls, project/session/inventory checks pass. The PubDoc closeout at `aceda471` verifies the fixed ECAL palette and preserved original ODD source-access date; both findings are closed. Final current-head hosted checks are verified after publication.

Editable sources, compact bin data, provenance and the attributed baseline decision are under `docs/publication/emcal-findings/` and `docs/design/inputs/ECAL-baseline-selection-2026-11-17.md`. Ongoing work/role/tool and exact available usage records are retained; active coordinator usage remains unavailable rather than estimated. No formal design lifecycle or human sign-off is fabricated.

This review response records four disjoint completed specialist turns: 15,484,025 input + 25,843 output = 15,509,868 observed tokens. Earlier canonical owners remain unchanged; active coordinator coverage is unavailable.

**PR145-PhysVal-comparison-contract**, reviewed `bc1c42bee37c3eff43bdd56a8d8d2f55566e344d`. The proposed four-series SVG is scientifically defensible.

Use **|η|** horizontally and **sample SD(R)/mean(R) [%]**, with `R=H/Etrue`, vertically. This is the retained raw-response interpretation of the requested σ(E)/E; it is not intrinsic fixed-energy resolution.

**Matched ledgers**

- [Original Si–W]([redacted] `signal_GeV / energy_GeV`. SHA256 `3ecf01973de2df1daae144d5179d2c465567af5f436168c2f785b77b892f0574`.
- [Staggered Si–W]([redacted] same fields. SHA256 `4fac66babe25d8a5e08821610b5122fd6219c6dce634f7b0db92034f93ba6907`.
- [LAr400]([redacted] **`H_GeV / energy_GeV`**. SHA256 `a591c521afffde7fe75ae8d2e6651918cde4e9dbaea0971d8a84646b5b12e74d`.

I verified all 10,000 `(event,E,η,φ)` tuples agree exactly across these ledgers. Uniform 0.05-wide |η| bins contain **136–189 common primaries**.

**Rebin-helper recipe**

1. Verify hashes, sort by event, require unique IDs0–9999 and identical primary coordinates.
2. Define 61 edges as `np.arange(61)/20`; include the final edge3.
3. Retain every event, including zeros. Compute each bin’s count, zeros, mean, sample SD (`ddof=1`) and SD/mean.
4. Generate 1000 whole-primary resamples using seed13001000. Apply each multiplicity vector jointly to all three models and projections; derive pointwise 2.5/97.5 percentiles.
5. Retain compact edges/counts/statistics/intervals and source hashes. Do not average fine-bin widths to reconstruct coarse widths.
6. Cross-check LAr bins1.1–1.6 against **`lar-gap10k/summary.json → views.H.models.candidate.projections.fine_transition`**. They are a check, not additional overlapping plotted points.

**ODD markers**

Use `bc1c42…:docs/validation/issue117/previews/nodd-digitized-response.json → showers.populations`, selecting:

`geometry="odd-zero"`, `particle="e-"`, `momentum_GeV=20`, `eta=0,1,2`.

Each point has200 events at φ0.123 rad. Plot markers/error bars **without connecting interpolation**:

| η | Width [%] | Source95% interval [%] |
|---:|---:|---:|
| 0 | 2.9257 | 2.6272–3.2111 |
| 1 | 3.7422 | 3.3572–4.0955 |
| 2 | 3.2242 | 2.9311–3.5013 |

Keys: `stages.raw.visible_fraction.RMS_over_mean` and `stages.raw.SD_over_mean_bootstrap.CI95`. Preserve their source5000-replicate uncertainty; do not merge it with the matched10k bootstrap.

The legend/caption must identify ODD’s unmatched fixed-point cohort and original detector scope, versus the three ECAL-only uniform10–80GeV/full-φ samples. Historical `ecal10k/summary.json` is **original realistic nODD Si–W, not ODD**. Exclude calibrated10k/20k curves from this raw comparison. LAr H remains saved-hit response; its separately measured unassigned deposit is not silently added.

The human comment explicitly selects LAr400 as the baseline. That selection does not supply missing ODD illumination or integrated-service qualification.

No plots, edits, native jobs, Monte Carlo or new bootstrap calculations were performed.

Independently checked the [SVG comparison]([redacted]

- Exact ledger/source hashes and all 10,000 matched primary identities.
- All **180 fine-bin** counts, zeros, means, sample SDs and widths.
